# Estus Health

> Neuroaffirming occupational therapy practice in Perth, Western Australia, with telehealth across Australia. A small team of neurodivergent clinicians (Liam Fagan, Nam Lang, Nik Peshwani) working with autistic adults and teens, PDA profiles, ADHD, late-diagnosed adults, and complex health (EDS, POTS, chronic fatigue, hypermobility). NDIS and private clients welcome.

Important notes:
- Every page is prerendered to static HTML at build time, so the full content is in the initial response and no JavaScript is required to read it.
- The sitemap at https://www.estushealth.com/sitemap.xml lists every indexable page.
- Contact: hello@estushealth.com

## Services

- [Occupational Therapy](https://www.estushealth.com/services/occupational-therapy): Neuroaffirming OT for autistic adults, teens, PDA profiles, and ADHD.
- [Gaming-Informed Therapy](https://www.estushealth.com/services/gaming-informed-therapy): Therapy that uses gaming as a genuine clinical medium.
- [Minecraft Program](https://www.estushealth.com/services/minecraft-program): Structured Minecraft-based therapy program for kids and teens.
- [Assessments & Reports](https://www.estushealth.com/services/assessments-reports): Functional capacity and OT assessments, including NDIS reports.

## About

- [Meet the Team](https://www.estushealth.com/team): The clinicians behind Estus Health.
- [Contact & Referrals](https://www.estushealth.com/contact): Referral form, discovery-call bookings, and contact details.
- [Events & Webinars](https://www.estushealth.com/events): Hub for live events and the permanent archive of past recordings.
- [Gaming-Informed Therapy Webinar](https://www.estushealth.com/events/gaming-informed-therapy): Full recording, chapter markers, and resources on using gaming as a clinical medium.
- [Boundary Setting Webinar](https://www.estushealth.com/events/boundary-setting): Full recording and resources on setting boundaries as a neurodivergent adult.

## Free Resources

- [All Free Resources](https://www.estushealth.com/resources): Hub for guides, tools, and self-reflection quizzes.
- [Understanding PDA](https://www.estushealth.com/resources/understanding-pda): Guide to Pathological Demand Avoidance.
- [Late Autism Diagnosis](https://www.estushealth.com/resources/late-autism-diagnosis): Guide for late-diagnosed autistic adults.
- [Executive Function & Complex Health](https://www.estushealth.com/resources/executive-function-complex-health): Executive function with chronic illness.
- [EDS & HSD](https://www.estushealth.com/resources/eds-hsd): Ehlers-Danlos syndromes and hypermobility spectrum disorders.
- [CommCard](https://www.estushealth.com/resources/commcard): About the free communication-card web app. The app itself runs at https://www.estushealth.com/commcard/ — tap-to-speak phrase cards for when words are hard, no login and no data stored.
- [The Shared Lexicon](https://www.estushealth.com/resources/lexicon): Shared vocabulary for neurodivergent experiences.
- [Open Loops](https://www.estushealth.com/resources/open-loops): Tool for managing unfinished tasks and mental load.
- [Second Brain](https://www.estushealth.com/resources/second-brain): External memory systems for ADHD and autistic brains.
- [Driving OT](https://www.estushealth.com/resources/driving-ot): Free driving resources, including the Give Way! WA road rules arcade at https://www.estushealth.com/giveway/.
